newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Baobab leaps after buys financial firm.
newsitem.headline: Baobab leaps after buys financial firm.

text.p: Shares in South African investment firm Baobab Solid Growth Ltd jumped to new highs in early trade after it upped its stake in specialist financial services firm Theta Securities (Pty) Ltd and it said it would move to the banking sector on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
By 0855 GMT Baobab was up 300 cents to 59 rand, a rise of over six percent in thin volume of 17,100 shares.
"It is racing away on reports in weekend newspapers that Theta is to reverse list through Baobab," one dealer said, adding that his brokerage had put out a buy recommendation on the stock.
"Our analyst reckons that it could grow earnings by as much as 40 percent per annum," the dealer said.

Baobab said that it will ask shareholders to approve a name change to Theta Ltd after buying 100 percent of that firm. Baobab also said that it was lifting its stakes in King Finance, Alternative Finance Ltd (Altfin) and Decimax.
It would issue 6.7 million shares to fund the investments.
Baobab last month bought a 25.1 percent stake in specialist voice processing company Voicematix.
